scientific_question: On the untouched NIST Chwirut1 ultrasonic calibration dataset, can the reusable frozen coverage driver evaluate a cubic/cubic candidate, continuous ellipsoid safety, pointwise residual bounds and bound composition without protocol drift or an inflated independence claim?

dataset_scope.name: NIST/ITL StRD Chwirut1
dataset_scope.native_model: Three-parameter exponential class for the NIST ultrasonic reference block study; the cubic/cubic rational candidate is an approximation stress test, not the native model
dataset_scope.reference: Chwirut, D., NIST (1979), Ultrasonic Reference Block Study

related_prior_dataset.name: Chwirut2
related_prior_dataset.scope: Chwirut2 was analyzed previously, but Chwirut1 observations were not used to design previous candidates or regions; this is not an independent model-family or laboratory replication test

implementation_rule.changes_after_freeze: No driver or wrapper change is permitted under this protocol; any implementation change requires a new protocol and preservation of this frozen analysis
implementation_rule.scope_correction: The new wrapper replaces only the generic driver's stale Filip-specific first limitation with the frozen Chwirut1 scope text; it does not alter fitting, certificates, bounds or thresholds

candidate_rule.optimizer: scipy.optimize.curve_fit method=lm, maxfev=200000, full_output=true; select lowest training RSS
candidate_rule.scope_limitation: The cubic/cubic candidate is only an approximation stress test and not the native Chwirut1 three-parameter exponential model; Chwirut1 shares its study and native model family with previously analyzed Chwirut2, so this is not an independent model-family validation
candidate_rule.retuning: No model, start, radius, fold or threshold changes after seeing outcomes

fold_rule.construction: Sort unique x values into five contiguous, nearly equal groups; repeated x never crosses fitting and test sets; every observation is evaluated once
fold_rule.baseline: Cubic polynomial fitted only on the other four groups; this is a candidate baseline, not the native three-parameter exponential fit

ellipsoid_rule.radius_scope: Fixed before fitting; a deterministic scale only, not a confidence level
ellipsoid_rule.covariance: Use denominator block from the best training attempt; require exact symmetry and positive definiteness
ellipsoid_rule.continuous_certificate: Require exact D^2-rho^2*z^T*Sigma*z>0 and sign-consistent D over each closed held-out interval
ellipsoid_rule.pointwise_bound: For R=rho*sqrt_upper(z^T Sigma z), require |D|-R>0 and compute prediction shift and observed residual upper bounds; compare with the independent box at the same radius
ellipsoid_rule.coverage: Check actual |y-f_snapshot| against each available deterministic residual bound and record any violation; do not call this probability calibration
ellipsoid_rule.composition: For each available point, preserve actual residual, prediction shift and residual upper bound so shift share can be audited without refitting

prohibitions: No claim that the native Chwirut1 model is cubic/cubic or that the candidate is physically endogenous
No description of Chwirut1 as independent of the previously analyzed Chwirut2 study or native model family
No description of this reanalysis as a newly performed independent physical experiment
No hiding of optimizer failures, non-positive covariance, unavailable bounds, coverage violations or prediction failures
No probability, confidence, RMSE-bound or continuous-x error-bound claim from pointwise bounds
No use of the original three-parameter certified fit as candidate holdout evidence
No retuning of starts, radius, folds or candidate degree after seeing candidate outcomes
